principle_violations.reason: The Order class is managing both order details (items, quantities, prices) and order status, as well as handling the addition of items, thereby having multiple responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of managing the status of orders from the Order class by creating a separate class for managing order status.

principle_violations.reason: Currently, adding a new payment method requires creating a new class and modifying existing code if new methods or attributes are needed, thus not being closed for modification.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface to handle common operations or the parameterization of processing logic to allow extensions without modifying original classes.
